rehab24.license: Academic/non-profit, non-commercial research only; attribution required
rehab24.citation: Cernek, Sedmidubsky and Budikova. REHAB24-6: Physical Therapy Dataset for Analyzing Pose Estimation Methods. SISAP, 2024.
rehab24.scenario: Exercise 6: squats; Camera17; real recordings with physiotherapist correctness labels; half-profile view and lights on in both classes
limitations: Staged correct/incorrect exercise executions; not evidence of patient diagnosis
Binary correctness annotations do not specify the error mechanism
Never tune thresholds on validation/test participants
Same viewpoint and lighting in both classes to reduce acquisition confounding

voiced.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
voiced.citation: Cesari et al. A new database of healthy and pathological voices. Computers & Electrical Engineering 68, 310-321, 2018. doi:10.1016/j.compeleceng.2018.04.008
voiced.scenario: Human sustained vowel recordings: healthy and pathological voices with source diagnoses
limitations: Not consultation speech; unsuitable for transcription or critical terms
Pathological voice label is not a fatigue, dyspnea or dysarthria diagnosis
Small convenience subset; no clinical performance claim
WFDB amplitudes converted to PCM16 without per-recording normalization

primock57.citation: Papadopoulos Korfiatis, Moramarco, Sarac and Savkov. PriMock57: A Dataset Of Primary Care Mock Consultations. ACL, 2022.
primock57.scenario: day1_consultation04 and day1_consultation06: human spoken mock consultations with respiratory complaints
limitations: Human recordings of role-play, not actual patient encounters
Cannot validate a vocal disease classifier using actor symptom descriptions
Patient-only channel includes listening silences; these must not be labeled pathological pauses
English samples need language support before end-to-end app evaluation

cross_dataset_policy: Keep sources and people separate. Do not fuse these independent people into a real patient case.
stage: Data preparation only; detector evaluation pending

bidmc.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
bidmc.citation: Pimentel et al. Towards a Robust Estimation of Respiratory Rate from Pulse Oximeters. IEEE TBME 64(8), 1914-1923, 2016. DOI:10.1109/TBME.2016.2613124
bidmc.scenario: Hospital heart rate and oxygen saturation numerics; record 01; 1 Hz
limitations: This subset contains no blood pressure
Thresholds used in replay are explicit engineering test settings, not clinical guidance
